assistant|the_lincoln_lawyer_plot: Described The Lincoln Lawyer: defense attorney Mickey Haller works from his Lincoln Town Car and defends wealthy real estate agent Louis Roulet, uncovering deceit and corruption.
assistant|mickey_haller_character: Described Mickey Haller as a smooth-talking, street-smart defense attorney and hustler with a conscience, wit, and personal demons.
assistant|mickey_haller_series: The Lincoln Lawyer (2005) is the first Mickey Haller book, introducing the defense attorney who works from his Lincoln Town Car.
The Brass Verdict (2008): Mickey inherits a lucrative practice from a murdered colleague and lands in a killer's crosshairs.
The Drop (2011): Mickey takes on a high-profile murder case involving a former client while dealing with personal demons.
The Gods of Guilt (2013): Mickey defends a former client accused of murder and uncovers a web of deceit.
The Crossing (2015): Mickey teams up with Detective Harry Bosch on a case involving a former client and a complex conspiracy.
The Law of Innocence (2020): Mickey is accused of murder and must clear his name.
assistant|series_reading_order: Advised the Mickey Haller books can be read standalone but are best read in order; suggested starting the Harry Bosch series with The Poet (1996) before crossing over.
assistant|book_community_recommendation: Recommended online forums: Goodreads, Book Club Forum, and Reddit's r/books for discussing The Lincoln Lawyer.

Recommended Facebook groups: Michael Connelly Fans and Mystery & Thriller Book Club.
